decisions.reason: This high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's established coding and inkjet know-how, and as a growing large firm with strong in-house development it is well placed to refine the product rather than withdraw it.

The backside numbering software module fits the firm's push toward digitalization, variable data and traceability, and its existing system integration and software portfolio give it enough related knowledge to improve a still-niche offering.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces is closely aligned with the firm's core competence in reliable marking on difficult materials, so early market feedback is likely to be absorbed and used for incremental improvement instead of exit.
